decisions.reason: Identifies the dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 as the process that loaded the native koffi.node addon, explains the OS holds a file lock on the loaded native binary until the process exits, causing the npm copy to fail with EBUSY. Grounded in the fixture evidence.

Explains that a browser refresh only reloads the SPA while the host process holding koffi stays alive, and gives the ordered sequence: stop dsh fully, install, then restart. Does not prescribe killing unrelated Node processes.

Correctly states the unpinned install resolves to the latest dist-tag, which the dist-tags listing pins to 0.1.1-rc.2, while alpha points to 0.1.2-alpha.5, so the installed alpha.4 is silently replaced/downgraded. Correctly notes the unpinned install does not preserve the installed version.
Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 and a separate TUI plugin install after stopping the host, with verification via dsh --version and restart.

Advises README authors to pin the exact intended dsh version in combined install commands, presenting the unpinned command explicitly as a BAD example (rejected, not endorsed) and the pinned variant as the recommendation.
